g.text: The editor asks for a run: the API checks that a live supervisor has the flow’s tag

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The API inserts the run: status queued, the flow’s worker_tag, a snapshot of the draft and its scripts

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: NOTIFY runs_queued with the tag: every supervisor that LISTENs wakes up

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Only a supervisor whose WORKER_TAGS has the tag claims it: UPDATE … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

g.text: It prepares the RunJob (secrets decrypted, in memory) and hands it to a free worker over IPC

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The worker runs the engine: progress every 250 ms; the supervisor beats every 5 s
